$comment: Harness benchmark matrix. API keys are NEVER stored here: each entry's
apiKeyEnv names an environment variable that bench/lib/keys.mjs fills in
from your local key stores (env var > niffler .env > opencode auth.json).
Model ids must exist on the given endpoints; see bench/README.md.

defaults.$comment: firstPromptBudget: warn (never fail) when a niffler first assistant prompt exceeds this many tokens — the direct-toolset + baseprompt footprint guard

$comment: Judgment provider for the niffler-expert harness variant. Reached via
NIF_LLM_PROVIDERS (second provider next to the worker's gateway), so a
cheap flash model judges while the worker keeps its own. syn:small:text
syn:large:text (GLM-5.3-Flash) for stronger judgment at ~1.5x input cost.
